imageGeneration.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: three-view source sheet for a clothing-video demo
Primary request: one sage-green rib-knit V-neck button cardigan shown as three photographs of the exact same garment
Scene/backdrop: seamless warm-white ecommerce studio
Subject: three equal vertical panels separated by wide clean warm-white gutters. Left panel is a full front view. Center panel is a full back view. Right panel is a close detail of the V neckline, matching buttons, rib-knit texture and one cuff edge.
Style/medium: photorealistic apparel product photography, invisible mannequin, realistic soft knit fabric
Composition/framing: landscape contact sheet, three equal vertical panels; full garment centered with generous padding in front and back panels; detail fills the third panel without crossing gutters
Lighting/mood: soft even studio light, accurate muted sage-green color, restrained ecommerce presentation
Constraints: exact same garment, sage-green color, V neckline, five matching buttons, rib-knit direction, cuffs, hem and proportions in all panels; no person; no hanger; no logo; no text; no watermark; clean straight gutters at exactly one-third and two-thirds of the canvas
Avoid: added embroidery, extra or missing buttons, pockets, props, dramatic shadow, cropped garment in front or back panels, panel labels

materialLimits: No person or scene reference is provided.
Do not generate a model, strong lifestyle scene, or continuous rotation.
Back and detail shots may only use the corresponding uploaded evidence.
